name: Tensei Shitara Kioku Soushitsu de Curry-ya Datta Ken
original_name: 転生したら記憶喪失でカレー屋だった件
source:
The main character "Kusada" lost his memory and collapsed at a mysterious curry shop.
So, the girl "Kochi", a clerk who is very close to the distance,
Meet the store manager "Shiba" who gives a cult-like curry quiz.
What is the store manager's intention, what is the lost memory, and what is the identity of the mysterious curry shop?
"--Even if I regain my memory, the tragedy is just waiting."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26197]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角“草田”失去了记忆，倒在一家神秘的咖喱店里。

在那里，他遇见了格外自来熟的少女店员“幸智”，以及总爱抛出冷门咖喱知识问答的店长“芝”。

店长究竟有何用意？失去的记忆是什么？这家神秘咖喱店的真面目又是什么？

“——就算找回记忆，也只有悲剧在等着你。”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26197]Freem![/url]]
